q: How do I calculate a broiler farm's emissions per kg of live weight?
title: Broiler farm emissions per kg
short: Add the farm's electricity for fans, lights and water at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and LPG or coal for brooding at their default factors, then divide by kg of live weight sold. Feed is usually the largest share, so add it from the feed mill's figure.
audience: Poultry integrators and contract broiler farmers

ul: Electricity for fans, cooling pads, lights and water pumps.
LPG, coal or wood for brooding chicks.
Feed, from the feed mill's footprint per tonne.

p: Divide by kg of live birds sold per batch. Report per batch, since summer batches use far more cooling power.

example.title: Worked example: one batch of 20,000 birds (illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 7,468 / 44,000 = 0.170 kg CO2 per kg live weight
Add feed and chicks from supplier figures for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your bills and batch records.

senseible: Senseible reads diesel, electricity and fertiliser invoices into dated, fingerprinted records that support a farm or crop figure. Field emissions such as N2O and methane are calculated with IPCC defaults in your method note and labelled as estimates, not measured values.
